items.text: No PMC water supply every Thursday; a second weekly cut day is being considered. Store water Wed night.
Katraj metro station work: heavy vehicles stopped at Navale Bridge, Shindewadi on trial.
Voter camps at all polling stations Oct 24–25. Register or change address before Oct 26.
SPPU warns Synergy School of Commerce isn't affiliated. Check affiliation before paying fees.
Police booked Rapido over unpermitted petrol bike taxis. Keep PMPML or metro as a backup.
Diwali: MSRTC plans 600+ special buses from Pimpri-Chinchwad, Swargate on Nov 4–7. Book early.
Sun block: no Panvel–Vashi locals 11:05 am–4:05 pm; Thane–Kalyan 5th/6th lines 9 am–1 pm.
BMC's 10% water cut continues (20% for industry and commercial). Fix leaks, skip long showers.
Bombay HC: no bursting crackers on public roads, all year, all festivals. Use permitted private spaces.
Santacruz stuck near 38°C after the monsoon's early exit. Carry water, avoid long midday walks.
FDA suspended 29 food licences, incl. Sophia College canteen and Janata Bakery, Jogeshwari.
Aqua Line passport: collect stamps at 10 stations for ₹250. Limited stock, digital payment only.
Bathukamma Carnival at Tank Bund from 6 pm Sun. Avoid Upper Tank Bund & Necklace Road 2–11 pm.
Singur reservoir is at 3.7 of 29.9 TMC; water board is cutting bulk supply. IT corridor: store water.
Metro + RTC common pass (₹400/day, ₹8,500/month) is under review. Do your math before buying.
Unknown WhatsApp 'money debited, reply NO' text? Don't reply. Block it. Cheated? Call 1930 fast.
TGPSC AEE and SSC JE exams clash on Nov 6. No date change yet; keep checking the TGPSC site.
Going home for Dussehra? Cyberabad police flag burglaries. Tell neighbours and your police station.
Puja Metro till Oct 20: Blue Line 1 pm–4 am, Green 1:30 pm–3:59 am. No Orange Line service.
Entry paused at Tala Pratyay, Chetla Agrani, Ballygunge, Salt Lake pujas after Saturday's crush. Check first.
Ten police help vans with women constables patrol pandals till Dashami to find lost kids and elders.
Bikes skidded on freshly painted Chingrighata flyover. Slow down on painted roads when wet.
New AC-59 bus: Bagkhal–Karunamoyee via Dakshineswar, Airport, New Town. Leaves Bagkhal 8:30, 9 am.
Mostly clear skies till Oct 23, highs near 31–32°C. Carry water while pandal-hopping.

chain.text: Tankers keep getting hit near Hormuz; crude stays above $100
Costly oil imports drag the rupee to 96.71 per dollar
RBI starts selling dollars straight to IOC, HPCL and BPCL
Wholesale fuel and power prices jump 26% in a year
Prices hit a 23-month high; RBI hikes to 5.50%, so loans cost more

data.title: gulf oil → your loan EMI
data.why: India buys most of its oil abroad in dollars. When the Gulf flares up, that cost travels through the rupee into prices and loan EMIs.

items.text: Heavy rain likely till Oct 26. Avoid low roads like Vyasarpadi; report waterlogging on 1913.
Fine rice at ₹30/kg at 11 Amutham and 19 cooperative stores. Up to 5 kg per person.
New Yellow Line, Poonamallee–Vadapalani: fares ₹10–40, last train 9 pm. Change at Vadapalani.
Ayudha Pooja flights to Hyderabad hit ₹21,665. Compare govt special buses or shift dates.
Southern Railway warns against loud music or reels on trains and stations. Carry earphones.
Tambaram station: 7 of 9 new lifts built; lifts and escalator works due by December.
Church Street sinkhole still cordoned; heavy vehicles banned until the BWSSB pipe below is fixed.
Pink Line safety nod expected soon; BMTC plans 5 feeder bus routes. Wait for the official opening date.
Dasara exodus jammed Mysuru, Tumakuru and Hosur roads for hours. Leave early or late, check live traffic.
Hospital bills must now show purchase cost, MRP and price charged. Ask for an itemised bill.
GBA voter drive is on. New to the city or just 18? Check your name on the ECI or GBA website.
KSRTC Mysuru sightseeing buses leave Bengaluru at 6 am daily till Oct 28. Book at ksrtc.in.
MCD wants safety certificates from 2,400+ PGs within 15 days. Ask your owner if yours is checked.
Half marathon Sun: Red, Yellow, Blue, Violet lines from 3:30 am. Plan central trips after noon.
Jantar Mantar is no longer an approved protest site; Ramlila, Burari and CBD Grounds replace it.
DU students flagged dark stretches at Siri Fort Rd and Mukherjee Nagar. In an emergency, dial 112.
E-bus charging opened at Anand Vihar ISBT, Rohini Sec-37, Nangloi, Keshopur depots; 150 e-buses due.
211 clean-air days so far, best since 2016. Winter smog usually hits in November; plan for it.
PMC: no water supply every Thursday from Oct 15. Fill up Wed night; complaints 1800-1030-222
Navratri: Mahatma Phule Rd near Bhavani Mata shut till Oct 20; SB Road diversions near Chatushrungi
SPPU: Synergy School of Commerce isn't affiliated. Check affiliation before paying any fees
Army Southern Command offers paid in-person internships in AI, cyber, drones from Nov 16
MPSC: 60-day judicial probe ordered, chairman on leave. Group C exam still listed for Jan 3
India vs WI T20 Wed 7 pm: take metro to Uppal/Stadium, reach by 5:30; heavy vehicles diverted
Singur dam low: water board cuts IIT-H, BHEL, ODF, BDL supply 20–50%. Fix leaks, store water
Fake 'debited, reply NO' WhatsApps: don't reply. Block, check bank app; lost money? Call 1930
HYDRAA: hostels in unsafe buildings must shift by 31 Dec. Never pay anyone claiming to be HYDRAA
KBR Park underpasses dropped for a 4.3 km elevated corridor; one-way loop stays for now
Diwali flights to Patna near ₹22,000; SCR runs ~600 special trains. Check berths before booking
New Poonamallee–Vadapalani metro runs 7 am–9 pm, fares ₹10–40. Change at Vadapalani
Planned power cuts 9 am–2 pm Oct 13–14 in Porur, Tambaram, Avadi, Mogappair. Charge up
IMD: northeast monsoon may arrive in 2–3 days. Keep umbrella handy, avoid flooded subways
Tambaram station to get 9 more lifts and 10 escalators by December
Turned 18 or moved? File Form 6 (new) or Form 8 (shift) and check your name on the roll
Protest diversions at Mandi House, CP Outer Circle, Lodhi Rd; metro gates near Rajiv Chowk may shut
Jantar Mantar dropped as protest site; Ramlila, Burari and CBD grounds named instead
Supreme Court hearing on protest and metro curbs moved to Thu, Oct 15
MCD sealed 282 and razed 47 unsafe buildings in a month. PG hunting? Check cracks, extra floors
After wettest October day since 2022, IMD sees a dry, warmer week. Light layer for mornings

chain.text: UN weather body: this El Niño may be among the strongest since 1950
Weak rains: drought in 217 of 240 Karnataka taluks, 388 AP mandals
Retail inflation hit 5.54% in Sept, a 23-month high; onions doubled
RBI already raised its key rate to 5.50% to cool prices
Pricier canteen meals now; floating-rate loan EMIs can rise too

data.title: El Niño → your thali and EMI
data.why: A warm Pacific means weaker rain, smaller harvests and costlier food. RBI fights that with higher rates, which also make loans dearer.

items.text: Puja metro: Blue & Green Lines run till 4 am Saptami–Navami; 6 am–11 pm on Oct 15–16
Puja curbs Oct 13–19: goods vehicles restricted, no parking on notified roads. Leave early
New AC-59 bus: Uttarpara to Salt Lake via airport, New Town; 8:30 & 9 am out, 5:30 & 6 pm back
Real Madrid vs Barcelona legends match tentatively Nov 25 at Yuva Bharati. Skip resale offers
BMC: 10% water cut continues (20% for commercial). Fix leaks, store only what you need
Santacruz hit 38°C Sunday, near October record. Carry water, avoid midday walks; slow relief ahead
Voter-list claims deadline extended to Oct 26; BMC to hold camps. Final roll Nov 16
From Oct 12, BMC fines debris trucks ₹25,000 if GPS tracker is off, to curb dumping and dust
BMC asks societies to check trees for cracks, leaning trunks, weak branches; report hazards
BMTC plans 5 feeder routes, 30 buses to Pink Line stations: JP Nagar, BTM, Hulimavu, Uttarahalli
Residents formed human chains on 80 & 100 Feet Roads against elevated corridors; plan not final
GBA conditionally okays felling 321 trees at KPTCL Hoodi substation for a power upgrade
Dating-app video call led to ₹1.85 lakh extortion. Don't pay; report at cybercrime.gov.in or 1930
Bengaluru Jatre, a 10-day citywide fest, runs Dec 4–13. Clubs and bands can register at bengalurujatre.in
